name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2025-05-31, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
